The flawed specification contains an error in the handling of the append operation. Specifically, the bug is in the statement that adds the second integer of the query to 'list' at the index equal to the current size of 'list'. This is redundant because adding an element to an ArrayList in Java using the add method automatically appends it to the end of the list. Additionally, the retrieval of the k-th last element should correctly calculate the index by subtracting k from the current size of the list and adjusting for zero-based indexing.
Repair Directions:
1. Remove the redundant index specification when adding an element to the list. Use the add method without specifying an index.
2. Correct the retrieval of the k-th last element by using the index `list.size() - k` to account for zero-based indexing.
